description: This circular chart visually compares ten distinct capabilities, each assigned a numerical score and labeled with a corresponding category name. The chart is structured as a ring divided into ten colored segments, arranged clockwise around a central white circle. The central circle contains three labeled sections: “Contradiction Resolution” (brown), “Context Tracking” (dark blue), and “Context Retrieving” (dark green). Each outer segment corresponds to a specific capability and is connected by a line to its label and score outside the ring. The capabilities and their scores are: “Prioritization” (100, light red), “Personalization” (100, orange-red), “Privacy Protection” (111, red), “Multitasking” (160, dark green), “Memorization” (100, light cyan), “Dynamic Instruction” (100, cyan), “Dynamic Environment” (100, dark blue), “Recursive Reasoning” (110, bright blue), “Triggering” (100, light blue), and “Context Retrieving” (100, dark green). The segments are visually arranged in descending order of their numerical scores, with “Multitasking” appearing largest and “Privacy Protection” slightly larger than “Recursive Reasoning.” The chart does not include a legend, nor are percentages shown within the slices; instead, the scores are displayed externally. The central sections appear to be labels for the overall framework rather than components of the score breakdown.
